# Creator QR Code

> Creator QR Code is a free QR code generator at https://creatorqrcode.com/. It creates static QR codes in the browser for a URL, plain text, WiFi network, vCard, email, SMS, or a small file, then downloads a PNG. Codes do not expire, do not use a tracking redirect, and do not add a watermark. QR content is processed locally and is not uploaded to create the code.

## Facts

- Site: https://creatorqrcode.com/
- Primary tool: free static QR code generator
- Price: free, no account required
- Output: high-quality PNG
- Customization: QR color, background, frame, shape, logo, size, and error correction L, M, Q, or H
- A logo upload switches error correction to High (H)
- File QR codes are limited to 100 KB so they stay scannable
- Privacy: files and QR content stay on the device for these browser tools
- The same site also has a QR scanner, PDF tools, image tools, calculators, device tests, and how-to guides

## Main pages

- [QR code generator](https://creatorqrcode.com/): create, customize, and download a QR code
- [Scan a QR code](https://creatorqrcode.com/pages/scan-qr.html): scan from a camera or an uploaded image
- [Calculators](https://creatorqrcode.com/calculators/): free browser calculators
- [Guides](https://creatorqrcode.com/blog/): how-to articles for QR codes, PDFs, images, and device checks
